'''Hyper Beam Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|<b>ATK</b>: {{Color|45375|7}}
<b>Attack Interval</b>: {{Color|8|7}}s
<b>Mode of Attack</b>: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a powerful beam to deal massive {{Color|Electric DMG|6}} to enemies. This tower prioritizes its attacks at high threat targets within range.|An upgraded version of the Beam Tower. Endfield Industries improved the stability of this weapon platform with Protocol Originium. Unfortunately, no effective solutions could be found for the massive energy consumption.}}
